title: 第1009章 重逢灵汐第1008章 相见娜娜
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
诸天万界因神纪元年神劫来临，魔域魔物魔神军大举冲过混沌界河，
让光明界黑灰之气笼罩，宇宙诸天一片杀伐与收割乌烟瘴气。
天级雷境帝子云并无看透未来之法，仅仅能通过察看天象，以及推断掐算一些因果，而且有关于他的前世记忆也不是太多。
他的这一世大奇遇太多，故，这一世的紧要记忆也超多，没时间恢复前世记忆。然，随着帝子云阶位越来越高，神通法术越来越强大，阅历底蕴越来越深厚。
在青剑道宗天机阁，在玄极剑宗玄机阁，在龙汉帝国星辰宫观摩天象乾坤，他至少这一世没有未来。至于何年何月，那便无法看清。
而星象玄机显照诸天万界万族，未来不久一片黑暗破灭，让帝子云汗毛倒竖。他这一世太短暂了，他的宇宙霸体以及全属性根本来不及全面修炼提升。
断断续续两千多年的他与动轨便是数十万，数百万，数千万年的老牌神级相比，与婴幼没有区别。而老牌神级以上还有仙级以及更高逆神天庭神圣，帝子云根本不想去面对差距现实。
以他目前洞察，逆神天庭甚至比魔域强悍。数不清的神纪元年以来，魔域不曾攻进天界九重天，而天界传说有九十九重天，也有说一百零八重天，而越是上面的天，越是强大无比。
而每次神劫神魔大战，天界几乎没有上层天参与神劫收割。也就是说，只是下面的低级神族就让诸天万界无法抵挡，成为屠宰场。完全没有可比性。
而正是如此，帝子云更加敬仰他的诸位师尊，以及龙汉帝国核心大长老。他们肯定比帝子云知道更多更为详尽，然他们世纪轮回，一直在与天界魔域抗争，为恢复龙汉天朝呕心沥血，为龙汉天朝的圣光庇佑万界而苦苦坚守。
一袭白衣出尘的帝子云抛开世事纷扰从玄极剑宗疾步而出，因正在察看天象的他收到他放飞大世界的雷击境晶片飞碟，那是他目前不需要耗费太多法力便能探查古玄世界的手段。
疾步带风间，黑金帝子战袍霎那间上身，魔龙黑翼展翅波动便宛如流星划破天际，一刹那进入神灵虚空，转眼降临数百亿里外凤舞大陆。
凤舞大陆狼烟四起，火光冲天，逆神天庭伪神打破虚空壁垒薄弱层，大举放进魔域高阶魔物魔兽入侵，让凤舞大陆措手不及。因凤舞大陆老牌神明与龙汉帝国一般，都在天外抗击魔神军与逆神天庭伪神大部。
修炼永无止境，没有岁月。帝子云与娃娃亲凤灵汐自年少一别便是两千多载，而天凤女凤灵汐已经正道正神，成为留守凤舞大陆核心主宰。
虽凤灵汐比帝子云的半神还强大很多，然他心急如焚，唯恐凤灵汐有一丝意外。在他心目中，娃娃亲凤灵汐的地位无可替代，因灵汐宝的信仰与他出奇一致，善良，同情弱小，热爱万族光明。
乌压压的魔兽就像黑色潮水涌向凤灵汐守护一部，刚出虚空，还在数十万丈高空，帝子云便接连打出他晋升天级雷境的最强芯片机械人，以及最强晶片战斗飞碟。
铺天盖地的芯片机械人以及晶片飞碟，霎那间狂风暴雨般杀向杀作一团的宛如光速杀向魔物魔兽。魔物魔兽与灵汐的守护一部杀作一团，他无法使用大范围杀剑，唯有融合的高武高科更加管用。
而高空帝子云去势不减，展翅一个龙在天涯，宛如黑龙咆哮，犹如罚世之剑超过光速，眨眼间便人剑合一，直接穿透一个躲在魔物魔兽间偷袭灵汐的逆神天庭伪神。
即使正神在帝子云半神这里也不好使，帝子云的交叉火力十八连天级半神法力恐怖如斯，霎那间便人剑合一穿透爆体两个此间最强正神，而血肉不沾衣袖丝毫，仿佛正神被爆灭与他无关。
谁说神级无法绞杀，谁说斩神需要天长地久？帝子云一剑破万古，用干净利落的爆灭吞噬正神昭告天下，杀神，他只需一剑。带着他的磁爆，魔煞，凶煞，时空大法，雷电大法，一旦被他的半神法力锁定，逃无可逃。

已经与魔物魔兽以及逆神天庭伪神激战许久的凤灵汐只感觉一股超级强大的神力到达，一直让她头痛的两个天界正神便消散于天地，她那俏皮灵动宛如青春无敌美少女的俏脸一刹那从震惊变成喜出望外。
因超强神力气息是她朝思暮想的傻木头。她们身为古玄世界年轻一代领袖，各自的重担被压得喘不过气，事务，军武，修炼缠身，年少一别便是两千多载，她不知为帝子云担心了多少，祈祷了多少。
只是她一刹那失神，便被那强有力的大手一把把她扛在宽阔肩膀，被那独有的混沌护体光盾层层保护，而他那独有的神域霎那间笼罩处于悲喜交加又幸福的灵汐。
灵汐的模样身段与呼延娜娜几乎如出一辙，她终于从两千多载别离重逢中的一刹那失神中回过神来，宛如小迷妹被帝子云扛在肩上；
“哇塞，哇哦，傻木头，还真是你回来了。傻木头，你更加强大英气逼人，就像灵汐的保护神。灵汐就知道危难时刻你一定会回来守护灵汐，就像两千多年前的蛮荒大陆之战。
灵汐保护万族好累呀，终于可以被你保护了。你知道灵汐这些年是如何想你吗？做梦都在想你踏着五彩祥云，带着龙汉帝国迎亲队伍，抬着八抬大红花轿，一路漫天烟花来迎娶灵汐。灵汐是万界最美，最幸福的新娘。”
在凤灵汐眼里，她的傻木头永远是天地间最强男神，最帅男神，最伟岸男神，最值得信赖男神，英俊无敌完美男神。帝子云仿佛就是守护她的晴天，有帝子云，她便拥有了一切。
帝子云自幼便习惯了灵汐宝的大大咧咧，上一刻凤灵汐还宛如仙女杀神，挡在她的部下之前与逆神天庭伪神和黑压压的魔物魔兽杀得不可开交，这一刻便成为清新脱俗小仙女叽叽喳喳个不停。
即使帝子云用了护体光盾层层保护背上的灵汐宝，还用他的主神域全面保护灵汐宝，帝子云仍然觉得不安全，再放出上百芯片机机械侠和战斗晶片飞碟层层保护，他才稍微心安。
与他一起升级的混沌阴阳绝世圣剑在手，泛着乾坤青红光芒，剑气如虹，一步三杀。
他如同来自地狱的收割机，宛如黑压压魔物魔兽灰黑兽潮飘零一抹红，剑气磅礴，剑芒如电。
混沌绝世圣剑逆光闪烁带着磁爆一路开瓢。所过之处，摧毁一切，搅碎一切，黑暗湮灭···
content_en:
Due to the coming of the Divine Tribulation in the first year of the Divine Era, all the worlds and worlds are surrounded by monsters and demonic armies that rush across the River of Chaos.
Let the black and gray energy of the light world be shrouded, and the universe and heavens will be filled with a miasma of killing and harvesting.
Emperor Ziyun of the Heaven Level Thunder Realm has no way of seeing into the future. He can only calculate some causes and effects by observing the celestial phenomena and inferring some causes and effects. Moreover, he does not have many memories of his past life.
He had too many great adventures in this life, so he had too many important memories in this life, and there was no time to restore the memories of his previous life. However, as Di Ziyun's rank became higher and higher, his magical powers and spells became more and more powerful, and his experience and background became deeper and deeper.
In the Tianji Pavilion of the Qingjian Dao Sect, in the Xuanji Pavilion of the Xuanji Sword Sect, and in the Star Palace of the Longhan Empire, he had no future at least in this life. As for the year and month, it is impossible to see clearly.
And the mysteries of the stars are revealed in all the heavens, all realms, and all races, and the darkness will soon be shattered, making Emperor Ziyun's hair stand on end. His life was too short, and there was no time for his cosmic hegemony and all attributes to be fully cultivated and improved.
Compared with the veteran gods who have been on the move for more than two thousand years, he is no different from an infant. As for the veteran gods and above, there are immortals and even higher anti-god heavenly beings, Di Ziyun doesn't want to face the reality of the gap at all.
Based on his current insight, the God-Anti-God Heaven is even more powerful than the Demon Realm. For countless years in the Divine Era, the Demonic Realm has not invaded the ninth heaven of heaven. Legend has it that there are ninety-nine heavens, and some say one hundred and eight heavens. The higher the heavens, the more powerful they are.
And every time there is a battle between gods and demons in the divine tribulation, there are almost no upper heavens in the heaven participating in the harvest of the divine tribulation. In other words, just the low-level gods below make all the heavens and worlds unable to resist and become a slaughterhouse. There is absolutely no comparison.
And precisely because of this, Di Ziyun respected his masters and the core elders of the Longhan Empire even more. They must know more and more details than Di Ziyun, but they have been reincarnating for centuries, fighting against the demonic realm of heaven, working hard to restore the Longhan Dynasty, and working hard to protect the holy light of the Longhan Dynasty from all over the world.
Di Ziyun, who emerged from the ashes in white clothes, put aside the troubles of the world and walked out of Xuanji Sword Sect quickly, because he was observing the celestial phenomena when he received the Lightning Strike Realm chip flying saucer that he released into the big world. It was currently a means for him to explore the ancient Xuan world without spending too much mana.
Quickly walking in the wind, the black-gold emperor's robe was lifted up in an instant, and the black wings of the demon dragon spread out and fluctuated like meteors across the sky. In an instant, he entered the void of the gods, and in a blink of an eye, he landed on the Fengwu Continent tens of billions of miles away.
The Fengwu Continent was filled with smoke and flames soaring into the sky. The pseudo-gods of the Anti-god Heaven broke the weak layer of the void barrier and unleashed a large-scale invasion of high-level monsters and monsters in the Demon Realm, catching the Fengwu Continent by surprise. Yin Fengwu, the veteran gods of the mainland, like the Longhan Empire, are fighting against the demon army and most of the false gods in the anti-god heaven.
Cultivation is never-ending and has no time. It has been more than two thousand years since Emperor Ziyun and his baby brother Feng Lingxi were separated since they were young. However, Feng Lingxi, the Tianfeng girl, has become a righteous person and has become the core ruler of Fengwu Continent.
Although Feng Lingxi was much more powerful than Di Ziyun's demigods, he was still anxious, lest Feng Lingxi had any accidents. In his mind, the status of his baby brother Feng Lingxi is irreplaceable, because Lingxibao's beliefs are surprisingly consistent with his. He is kind, sympathetic to the weak, and loves the light of all races.
The swarming monsters were like a black tide rushing towards Feng Lingxi's guardian unit. Just out of the void, still hundreds of thousands of feet in the air, Di Ziyun successively launched the strongest chip robot and the strongest chip combat flying saucer that he had promoted to the Heaven Level Thunder Realm.
Overwhelming chip robots and chip flying saucers, all of a sudden, they were killing each other like a violent storm, and they were like monsters and monsters that were killing each other at the speed of light. The guardians of Monsters, Warcraft and Lingxi are all killing each other. He cannot use a large-scale killing sword. Only the fused Gaowu High Tech is more effective.
However, the power of Emperor Ziyun high in the sky remains unabated, spreading its wings like a dragon at the end of the world, roaring like a black dragon,Just like the sword of punishment surpassing the speed of light, in the blink of an eye, the human sword merged into one, and directly penetrated the false god of the anti-god heaven who was hiding among the monsters and beasts to sneak up on the soul.
Even the righteous god is not able to work with the demigod Di Ziyun. The crossfire of Di Ziyun's eighteen consecutive heaven-level demigods is so frightening. In an instant, the two strongest righteous gods in the world are penetrated by the combined swords, and their flesh and blood are not touched at all, as if he has nothing to do with the righteous god's destruction.
Who said that a god cannot be strangled, and who said that it takes forever to kill a god? Emperor Ziyun broke through eternity with one sword, and devoured the God of Righteousness with a clean explosion, telling the world that he only needed one sword to kill the God. With his magnetic explosion, demonic evil, fierce evil, time and space magic, and thunder and lightning magic, once locked by his demigod magic, there is no way to escape.
Feng Lingxi, who had been fighting fiercely for a long time with the monsters and the false gods of the anti-god heaven, only felt the arrival of a super powerful divine power, and the two heavenly gods that had been giving her a headache disappeared into the sky and the earth. Her playful and agile face, like an invincible young girl, changed from shock to overjoyment in an instant.
Because the super powerful divine aura is something she longs for day and night. As the young leaders of the ancient Xuan world, they were overwhelmed by their respective burdens. They were burdened with affairs, military affairs, and training. It had been more than two thousand years since they were young. She didn't know how much she worried about Di Ziyun and how much she prayed.
But she lost consciousness for a moment, and then the strong hands carried her on the broad shoulders, and she was protected layer by layer by the unique chaotic body light shield, and his unique divine realm was instantly enveloped in a soul filled with sorrow, joy, and happiness.
Lingxi's appearance and figure were almost the same as Huyan Nana's. She finally recovered from the moment of confusion after more than two thousand years of separation, and she was like a little fangirl being carried on Di Ziyun's shoulders;
"Wow, wow, silly wood, you are really back. Silly wood, you are even more powerful and heroic, just like Lingxi's protector. Lingxi knew that you would come back to protect Lingxi in times of crisis, just like the battle on the barbaric continent more than two thousand years ago.
It’s so tiring for Lingxi to protect all races. I can finally be protected by you. Do you know how Lingxi has missed you these years? I dream about you riding on the colorful auspicious clouds, leading the Longhan Empire's wedding procession, carrying eight red sedans, and fireworks all the way to marry Lingxi. Lingxi is the most beautiful and happiest bride in the world. "
In Feng Lingxi's eyes, her stupid boy will always be the strongest, most handsome, stalwart, most trustworthy, invincible and perfect male god in the world. Di Ziyun seemed to be the sunny sky protecting her. With Di Ziyun, she had everything.
Di Ziyun has been accustomed to Lingxibao's carelessness since he was a child. One moment, Feng Lingxi was like a fairy killer, standing in the way of her men and killing the false gods of the anti-god heaven and the black monsters and monsters. At this moment, she became a fresh and refined little fairy who kept chattering.
Even though Di Ziyun used the protective light shield to protect the Ling Xi Bao on his back, and also used his main divine domain to fully protect the Ling Xi Bao, Di Zi Yun still felt unsafe. After releasing hundreds of chip robots and combat chip flying saucers to protect him, Di Zi Yun finally felt at ease.
The Chaos Yin-Yang Peerless Holy Sword that was upgraded together with him is in his hand, glowing with the green-red light of the universe. The sword energy is like a rainbow, and he can kill three times in one step.
He is like a harvester from hell, like a black monster and a wave of gray-black beasts with a flash of red. His sword energy is majestic and his sword shines like lightning.
The peerless holy sword of chaos flashed against the light and opened with a magnetic explosion. Wherever it passes, it destroys everything, shatters everything, and darkness annihilates...
